summary.headline: Astrological Topics and Omens
summary.text: Catalog of astrological topics in a Florentine codex, including applications, interventions, conjunctions, void of course, enclosures, planetary rejoicing, beams, ascensional times, lots, spear-bearing, and planetary significations. It continues with weather omens, earthquakes, and references to codex 12 and Wachsmuth’s edition of Lydus.
